svg.title: Cristian Barreiro — Phase 4 circuit and button layer expansion
svg.desc: The original banner remains a static embedded image. Smooth localized luminous overlays are derived only from the validated Phase 2 selections and Phase 4 extracted source-pixel masks.
svg.metadata: 9-second seamless SVG animation. Original composition remains static. The existing composition remains static beneath independently controlled Phase 2 glow effects and Phase 4 raster selections. No banner geometry has been reconstructed. The terminal cursor remains part of the base.
